title: No Culture Left Behind: Massively Multi-Cultural Knowledge Acquisition & LM Benchmarking on 1000+ Sub-Country Regions and 2000+ Ethnolinguistic Groups

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using a zero-shot true-or-false binary classification task on the CultureAtlas dataset, which consists of positive (factual) and negative (adversarially generated) cultural knowledge assertions spanning various topics like holidays, cuisine, and education.

Comparing model performance on cultural norms across high-resource, mid-resource, and low-resource regions, as well as contrasting performance between general country-level knowledge and specific sub-country/province-level regional knowledge.
Probing the models' zero-shot true/false inference capabilities on fine-grained cultural knowledge assertions specific to over 2,500 distinct ethnolinguistic groups.
Assessing the drop in language model accuracy when evaluating general cultural knowledge versus fine-grained knowledge assertions specific to different religious groups.
